name: EA_CCIT3_1-01
summary: This EA trades based on zero-line crossovers of a CCI T3 smoothed indicator. It opens a buy when CCIT3 crosses above zero and a sell when it crosses below zero. An optional trade overturn mode reverses positions on opposite signals, and a trailing stop feature manages open positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CCI T3平滑指标的零线交叉进行交易。当CCIT3从负转正时开多仓，从正转负时开空仓。可选的反转交易模式在出现反向信号时翻转仓位，并附带移动止损功能管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI（商品通道指数）经过T3双重平滑处理后的零线交叉信号进行动量交易。入场条件为：当CCIT3指标值从正值穿越到负值时开空单，从负值穿越到正值时开多单，仅在无持仓时开仓。出场条件包括：固定止盈TP（默认1750点）、可选止损SL（默认0即无止损）、以及移动止损trail功能。当启用Trade_overturn模式时，持仓遇到反向信号会先平仓再反向开仓。仓位管理方面，Lots参数固定手数，若启用Max_drawdown则根据账户余额与最大回撤比例动态调整手数。资金管理存在明显缺陷：默认SL=0意味着没有止损保护，风险极大。移动止损逻辑在多头时以Bid减去trail点数作为止损位，空头时以Ask加上trail点数作为止损位，逐步跟进盈利仓位。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum trading using zero-line crossovers of a CCI indicator smoothed with the T3 moving average algorithm. Entry conditions: open a buy when CCIT3 crosses above zero (previous bar > 0, current bar <= 0 is the signal check reversed — CCIT3[0]<=0 && CCIT3[1]>0 triggers buy, CCIT3[0]>=0 && CCIT3[1]<0 triggers sell), only when no position exists. Exit conditions include a fixed TP of 1750 points, an optional SL which defaults to 0 (no stop loss), and a trailing stop feature. When Trade_overturn is enabled, the EA closes and reverses the position upon receiving an opposite crossover signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size by default, but if Max_drawdown is set above zero, the lot size scales proportionally to Account Balance divided by Max_drawdown, capped at the symbol's maximum volume. A critical money management flaw is the default SL=0, leaving positions without any hard stop loss protection. The trailing stop logic adjusts the stop loss level as price moves favorably, tracking by a fixed number of points behind the current price.

parameters.name: SL
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (0=no stop loss)

parameters.name: N_modify_sltp
parameters.description: 修改止损止盈最大重试次数

parameters.name: Max_drawdown
parameters.description: 最大回撤参考值（0=禁用动态手数）
parameters.description_en: Max drawdown reference value (0=disable dynamic lots)

parameters.name: Trade_overturn
parameters.description: 是否启用反向交易（反转仓位）

pros: 使用T3平滑算法处理CCI信号，减少虚假交叉和噪音
提供两种指标模式（Simple和noReCalc），增加策略灵活性
支持移动止损功能，能够锁定浮盈
有新K线判断逻辑，避免同根K线重复交易
修改止损止盈有重试机制，提高订单修改成功率
pros_en: Uses T3 smoothing algorithm on CCI signals, reducing false crossovers and noise
Provides two indicator modes (Simple and noReCalc) for strategy flexibility
Supports trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits
Has new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trades on the same bar
Retry mechanism for SL/TP modification increases order modification success rate
cons: 默认SL=0，没有止损保护，风险极高
仅支持单品种单持仓交易，无法多品种运行
移动止损使用全局变量Trail_stop，EA重启后会丢失状态
close()函数中调用GetLastError()但未使用返回值，错误处理不完善
SLTP修改请求缺少position ticket，在多仓位环境下可能失败
noReCalc版本指标的循环方向为正向（i=0到start），T3递推计算顺序错误导致指标值不准确
cons_en: Default SL=0 provides no stop loss protection, creating extreme risk exposure
Only supports single symbol single position trading, cannot run on multiple symbols
Trailing stop uses a global variable Trail_stop that resets on EA restart
close() function calls GetLastError() without using the return value, poor error handling
SLTP modification request lacks position ticket, may fail in multi-position environments
noReCalc version loops forward (i=0 to start) which is wrong for T3 sequential calculation, producing inaccurate indicator values
improvements: 添加默认止损值，避免无止损风险敞口
修复noReCalc版本的正向循环问题，应改为从历史到当前逐根递推
在SLTP修改请求中添加position ticket字段，确保修改正确仓位
增加持仓检查的magic number过滤，避免干扰其他EA的仓位
Trail_stop应持久化存储或从当前仓位SL重新计算，避免重启丢失
improvements_en: Add a default stop loss value to avoid unprotected risk exposure
Fix the noReCalc version's forward loop issue — should iterate from oldest to newest bar for correct T3 sequential calculation
Add position ticket to SLTP modification requests to ensure the correct position is modified
Add magic number filtering in position checks to avoid interfering with other EAs' positions
Trail_stop should be persisted or recalculated from current position SL to survive EA restarts

risk_points: 默认无止损（SL=0），单笔交易可能造成巨大亏损
无点差过滤，在宽点差品种上可能导致不利入场
仅支持单品种持仓，无多仓位隔离机制
SLTP修改请求缺少position ticket，可能修改错误仓位
risk_points_en: Default no stop loss (SL=0), a single trade can cause massive losses
No spread filter, wide-spread instruments may result in unfavorable entries
Single symbol position only, no multi-position isolation mechanism
SLTP modification request lacks position ticket, could modify wrong position
